# causal

Causal inference from data: estimators of average treatment effects (regression adjustment, propensity scores and inverse probability weighting, matching, stratification, entropy balancing, AIPW, TMLE and double machine learning), quasi-experimental designs (difference in differences and event studies, synthetic control, regression discontinuity, instrumental variables), heterogeneous effects (meta-learners, causal forests, uplift trees) and sensitivity analysis (E-values, Rosenbaum bounds, omitted-variable bias). Graph-side identification and discovery live in `pgm/causal`.

- structure `data.ts` (file): CausalData: covariates, binary treatment and outcome shared by estimators. `src/lib/causal/data.ts:1` `omai-engine/causal`

- function `aipw`: Augmented inverse-probability-weighted treatment effect. `src/lib/causal/estimation.ts:546` `omai-engine/causal`
- function `differenceInDifferences`: Difference-in-differences with event studies and synthetic control. `src/lib/causal/designs.ts:153` `omai-engine/causal`
- function `doubleMachineLearning`: Double machine learning treatment effect with cross-fitting. `src/lib/causal/estimation.ts:856` `omai-engine/causal`
- function `matching`: Matching estimator of a treatment effect. `src/lib/causal/matching.ts:174` `omai-engine/causal`
